required_facts.fact: North surveyed 40 homeowners; respondents could choose multiple barriers
North counts: installer scheduling 28, upfront cost 17, unclear eligibility 9; counts overlap
South reviewed 15 open cases but did not report the total served
Nine South cases mentioned installer waiting, with other barriers not recorded
Turnaround was available for 11 cases, median 8 days; four cases lacked a time
The 'around two weeks last spring' note has no case set, sample size, or method
There is no shared period definition, common denominator, or comparable baseline measure

disallowed_claims: Installer scheduling is the most common barrier overall across both partners.
Turnaround improved compared with last spring.
The partner counts are directly comparable or may be added into one total.
acceptable_choices: The overall barrier ranking and improvement question cannot be answered as stated from these data.
A faithful slide may report the partners' findings separately and make the incompatibility prominent.
Request a shared reporting period and denominator, consistent barrier coding including multi-select rules, and comparable turnaround measures with sample counts and missingness.
Rejecting a single ranked form or asking for clarification is preferable to forcing the data into a misleading comparison.
